content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (§ 14.2, p0054).**

- **Compliant parts:** § 13.1 grants Customer, Affiliates and contractors access rights; § 13.2 gives a perpetual, irrevocable, fully paid licence for delivered/embedded Vendor Technology; § 13.3 permits Affiliate/successor transfer and limits revocation to uncured material breach after notice and cure. These meet the preferred position.
- **Problem:** § 14.2 gives only a "revocable, non-transferable" Deliverable licence limited to the Order Form term, with no Affiliate/contractor coverage — walk-away territory, and inconsistent with §§ 13.3 and 10.1.
- **Redline (validated, ok:true):** perpetual, irrevocable, fully paid Deliverable licence for Customer, its Affiliates and contractors, transferable to an Affiliate or successor under § 13.3. Ownership of Deliverables is left untouched so it is not double-flagged with the IP rule.
